in_hebrew.name: Gabbey
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Gabbey הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek name Gabrielle, which is the feminine form of Gabriel. In the Bible, Gabriel is an archangel who delivers important messages from God.

in_greek.name: Gabbey

in_greek.long_meaning: Gabbey είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Greek name Gabrielle, which is the feminine form of Gabriel. In the Bible, Gabriel is an archangel who delivers important messages from God.

in_latin.name: Gabbey
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Gabriel's woman
in_latin.long_meaning: Gabbey est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Greek name Gabrielle, which is the feminine form of Gabriel. In the Bible, Gabriel is an archangel who delivers important messages from God.
